description.zh:
开启或关闭数据库代理，取值：

* **Startup**：开启代理服务
* **Shutdown**：关闭代理服务
* **Modify**：修改代理服务
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable or disable the database proxy feature. Valid values:

*   **Startup**: enables the feature.
*   **Shutdown**: disables the feature.
*   **Modify**: modifies the configuration of the feature.
The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID.
A deprecated parameter. You do not need to specify this parameter.

description.zh:
开通代理实例数量，取值：**1**~**16**。默认值：**1**。

>更多的代理实例能处理更多的请求，您可以根据监控数据了解代理实例的负载，然后设置合理的代理实例数量。
description.en:
The number of proxy instances that are enabled. Valid values: **1** to **16**. Default value: **1**.

>  The capability of the database proxy to process requests increases with the number of proxy instances that are enabled. You can monitor the load on the instance and specify an appropriate number of proxy instances based on the load monitoring data.

description.zh:
数据库代理实例类型，取值：
- **common**：通用型代理
- **exclusive**：独享型代理（默认值）
description.en:
The database proxy type. Valid values:

*   **common**: general-purpose database proxy
*   **exclusive** (default): dedicated database proxy

description.zh:
节点CPU核数，取值**1**~**16**。
>选择**DBProxyNodes**时，该参数必选。
description.en:
The number of CPU cores of the node. Valid values: **1** to **16**.

>  This parameter is required when you configure the **DBProxyNodes** parameter.

description.zh:
可用区中代理节点数量，取值**1**~**2**。
>选择**DBProxyNodes**时，该参数必选。
description.en:
The number of proxy nodes in the zone. Valid values: **1** and **2**.

>  This parameter is required when you configure the **DBProxyNodes** parameter.

description.zh:
节点所在的可用区 ID。
>选择**DBProxyNodes**时，该参数必选。
description.en:
The ID of the zone in which the node resides.

>  This parameter is required when you configure the **DBProxyNodes** parameter.

description.zh:
实例的网络类型。当前仅支持VPC网络，取值：**VPC**。

> 开启数据库代理时，该参数必选。
description.en:
The network type of the instance. Only the VPC network type is supported. Set the value to **VPC**.

>  If you enable the database proxy feature for the instance, you must specify this parameter.

description.zh:
是否开启连接保持。取值：
- **Enabled**：开启连接保持
- **Disabled**：关闭连接保持

> - 仅RDS MySQL支持此参数。
> - 修改连接保持状态时，**ConfigDBProxyService**取值为**Modify**。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable persistent connections. Valid values:

*   **Enabled**
*   **Disabled**

> 

*   This parameter is available only for instances that run MySQL.

*   If you want to modify persistent connections, you must set the **ConfigDBProxyService** parameter to **Modify**.
The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list.

description.zh:
实例所属VPC ID。可调用DescribeDBInstanceAttribute接口查询。

>开启数据库代理时，该参数必选。
description.en:
The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) to which the instance belongs. You can call the DescribeDBInstanceAttribute operation to query the ID.

>  If you enable the database proxy feature for the instance, you must specify this parameter.

description.zh:
实例所属虚拟交换机ID。可调用DescribeDBInstanceAttribute接口查询。

> 开启数据库代理时，该参数必选。
description.en:
The ID of the vSwitch to which the instance belongs. You can call the DescribeDBInstanceAttribute operation to query the ID.

>  If you enable the database proxy feature for the instance, you must specify this parameter.

title.zh: 开通或修改数据库代理实例功能

descriptions.zh:
### 适用引擎

- RDS MySQL
- RDS PostgreSQL

> 云数据库RDS MySQL集群系列于2023年10月17日起逐步在各个单元赠送代理数量为1的数据库独享代理服务，详情请参见[【优惠】RDS MySQL集群版赠送代理数量为1的数据库独享代理服务](~~2555466~~)。

### 相关功能文档
><notice>使用该接口前，请仔细阅读功能文档，确保完全了解使用接口的前提条件及使用后造成的影响后，再进行操作。></notice>

- [RDS MySQL开通数据库代理](~~197456~~)
- [RDS PostgreSQL开通数据库代理](~~418272~~)
descriptions.en:
### [](#)Supported database engines

*   MySQL
*   PostgreSQL

>  Starting October 17, 2023, ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instances that run RDS Cluster Edition offer one free-of-charge dedicated database proxy for each unit in phases. For more information, see [\[Special offers/Price changes\] One dedicated proxy is provided free of charge for ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instances on RDS Cluster Edition](~~2555466~~).

### [](#)References

>  Before you call this operation, read the following topics and make sure that you fully understand the prerequisites and impacts of this operation.

*   [Enable the database proxy feature of ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL](~~197456~~)
*   [Enable the database proxy feature of ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL](~~418272~~)

example.unifiedCli: aliyun rds modify-db-proxy --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --config-db-proxy-service Startup --db-proxy-instance-num 1 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-network-type VPC --vpc-id vpc-0000 --vswitch-id vsw-0000 --db-proxy-engine-type normal --db-proxy-instance-type exclusive --resource-group-id rg-acfmy0000 --persistent-connection-status Disabled --db-proxy-nodes cpuCores=1 zoneId=cn-hangzhou-c nodeCounts=2 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun rds ModifyDBProxy --region cn-hangzhou --DBProxyInstanceNum 1 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmy0000' --PersistentConnectionStatus Disabled --DBInstanceId 'rm-uf6wjk50000' --VPCId 'vpc-0000' --VSwitchId 'vsw-0000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DBProxyNodes '[{"cpuCores":"1","zoneId":"cn-hangzhou-c","nodeCounts":"2"}]' --DBProxyInstanceType exclusive --ConfigDBProxyService Startup --InstanceNetworkType VPC --DBProxyEngineType normal
